name: NV Plugins
description: nv-plugins 4.43.0: eclipsia swap-in - 13 providers replaced with the codeberg eclipsia/nuvio-plugin sources the user pointed at (anikototv/zyrvael, playimdb/zevran, purstream/wrenok, moviesdrive/vornix, cinemacity/svartok, vidfast/nyxora, cinefreak/novus, moviebox/mavonyx, movieshunt/kryxalia, castle/karnis, movieblast/jyniq, 4khdhub/hexion, vidlink/haylox) and 10 providers ADDED per the same user directive (bingr, vegamovies, showbox, reanime, animeworld, vidcore, animesalt, vidking, vidrock, ctgmovies) - 32 -> 42 scrapers. All 23 files are the readable eclipsia implementations with device-killer fixes only: guarded atob (realm may lack it), require(crypto-js) -> embedded pure-JS crypto (castle AES subset, HMAC-SHA256 parity-verified vs node:crypto, TripleDES-CBC parity-verified vs node:crypto), require(cheerio) -> embedded nv cheerio-lite v2 (parity-tested vs real cheerio), URLSearchParams -> nvQs, TextDecoder -> nvUtf8Decode, retry sleeps guarded (realm timers optional), and 7 corrupted a-href selectors in the eclipsia sources repaired (their lanes silently returned nothing upstream). Subtitles: English/Tagalog tracks pass through wherever upstream provides them; dual-audio rows keep their language labels; provider settings (audio/dub toggles, FebBox token) preserved where the eclipsia file exposes them. Untouched per standing rules: netmirror (verbatim soryn), torrents/torrentio merge + seeders floor, kisskh/asianhub/pinoyhub/tagalogtorrents, cinejoy, miruro, pencuri, nakios, topcartoons, animotvslash, hdhub4u, videasy, vidlove, peachify, cineby, fibwatch, xpass - all byte-identical to 4.42.0. nv-plugins 4.42.0: netmirror v17.0.0 is now VERBATIM the readable implementation the user pasted (soryn shape: plain constants + small async functions, 341 lines/11.6KB vs v16's 1,040 lines) - 'please replace netmirror with pasted code' honored literally. The only addition is a guarded globalThis.atob fallback prepended above the paste, because device runtimes may lack global atob (every previously device-validated netmirror guarded it) and a raw atob ReferenceError would kill all four NewTV platform lanes. With the paste, the Alpha lane and the nvio post-filter tail are gone; the pasted code self-enforces the >=720p floor via its own meetsQualityFilter, is fail-soft per platform, and passes captions through unfiltered (soryn parity). Sandbox: 125988 S1E1 -> net27 1080p +4 subs in 0.6s; junk-id and tv-without-s/e fail-soft [] with no hang; NewTV domains fail-fast from datacenter IPs (retail/device IPs reach them directly, as device-verified in earlier rounds). All other 31 providers byte-identical to 4.41.0. nv-plugins 4.41.0: netmirror v16.0.0 flat soryn port - the file now reads top-to-bottom exactly like the eclipsia soryn.js the user pasted (plain constants + async functions, no classes/state machines/polyfill blocks): 59,339B/1,429 lines -> ~39.5KB/1,040. Lanes kept: net27 embed-tmdb, NewTV (device-hardened vs soryn: 24-domain sequential probe -> 6 concurrent + 60s negative memo + single-flight, so a failed probe can no longer burn 24 dead fetches per call), and the user-validated Alpha lane (Alpha rows only, pure-JS HMAC-SHA256 signed watchpvr). soryn's while(true) episode pagination is capped (8 pages/12 seasons/18-fetch budget), watchpvr retries 3->2, no timers anywhere. onSettings dropped (hasSettings:false); captions fixed to the v15 default English+Filipino. All other 31 providers byte-identical to 4.40.0. nv-plugins 4.32.0: torrents = ONE merged torrent provider (Torrentio + TorrentsDB backends, seeders >= 5 hard floor, 720p/1080p rows only, debrid gear-icon support) - torrentio.js removed as redundant. Playback fixes: anikototv v1.2.0 emits the tokened master plus an ALT host row (ncdn.imgnex.top; same token verified valid on both CDN hosts), miruro v2.9.0 unchanged. Stream-source fixes: videasy v2.1.0 returns the streams it finds inside the 8s budget (progressive 6.8s deadline - previously all rows were raced away), vidlove v2.0.0 re-pointed to the live player API api.vidlove.cc (routes recovered from the player bundle), xpass v2.0.0 ports the site's own AES-GCM v3 data lane (key = SHA256 over the signed token, decrypt verified against the live blob), and moviebox/vidfast/peachify gained the api.vidlove.cc fallback lane (moviebox2 / ipcloud+megaknight / warden+tcloud server subsets). moviesdrive follows the site's host rotation (new1 -> new4) and parallelizes archive resolution. peachify re-enabled. vidlink/cineby verified healthy - vidlink only returns 0 rows for titles whose upstream tops out below 720p (pack rule), and cinemacity remains Cloudflare-gated from datacenter IPs (device-validated historically).

Self-contained fail-soft: meetsQualityFilter >=720p, per-platform try/catch, module.exports = { getStreams }. Only addition vs the paste: guarded globalThis.atob fallback (device runtimes may lack global atob). No timers, no Alpha lane, no post-filter tail.

scrapers.name: Miruro
scrapers.description: Miruro v2.9.0 - DEVICE FIX: restores the device-proven v2.7.0 base (fail-open post-filter, CDN hint rotation, ani.zip mal+ani dual-route, pipe circuit breaker, deadline) and grafts the 2026-09 MegaPlay API fix: getSourcesNew AES "enc" decrypt + signed master.m3u8 token. Root cause of the device zero-rows: v2.8.0 took CryptoJS from the harness-only __nvRequire shim which does not exist in the real Nuvio runtime (require("crypto-js") is what the app provides) - so every decrypt failed silently on devices. Serves anikoto:* catalog ids as before.

scrapers.name: Pencuri
scrapers.description: Malaysian/Indonesian/Japanese/Thai movies & series from pencurimovie.baby (paired with the asian-catalog addon's 9 Pencuri sections: Movies, Series, Malaysia, Indonesia, Japan, Thailand, Most Viewed, Most Rating, Top IMDb). Plays catalog rows DIRECTLY by navigating the site's real page or episode page (asian:pen-<slug> rows, zero title searching) and resolves TMDB ids by site search for everything else. v1.4.0 ENGLISH SUBTITLES on every row (opensubtitles-v3, parallel fail-soft lanes). v1.3.0 MULTI-SERVER FIX (user report: only 1 stream and its not playing - have 8 server): Streamtape /e/ pages carry TWO get_video links and the #robotlink DIV token (v1.2.0's pick) is a DECOY answering 403/500; the provider now evaluates the innerHTML expression (eval-free: string literals + chained .substring with JS semantics) to get the REAL token, which 302s to tapecontent.net (verified 720p + 1080p) and re-signs per request at play time; quality labels come from the embed page's own filename with zero extra requests. NEW StreamHG lane for hgcloud.to/hglink.to (2 of 8 servers, was an unparseable stub): loader rotates to audinifer.com whose radix-36 packed script unpacks to a signed master.m3u8 (206 verified); quality from the playlist RESOLUTION line. unpackPackedScript is now radix-aware (10..62). Dead-filler voe embeds (Big Buck Bunny placeholder, verified on the sample) are rejected via a placeholder guard. dedupeRows keys the FULL url (Streamtape file ids live in the query - the old query-strip collapsed both embeds into one row). Dood (playmogo/dsvplay) stays turnstile-aware: the gate is unconditional (verified desktop UA / mobile UA / cookie attempts), so gated pages skip in milliseconds. Lanes: MixDrop packed unpack to mxcontent.net mp4, Streamtape expression-token get_video, StreamHG signed m3u8, Dood pass_md5, Voe JS-redirect follow, inline probe for unknown hosts - all parallel, all fail-soft, all hasTimers()-guarded. Hermes-safe: no unescape/escape/btoa/atob.

scrapers.name: Cinejoy
scrapers.description: Cinejoy v3.0.0: device-realistic waterfall. 4.36.0 root cause: the QuickJS plugin runtime ships NO timers and every fetch is one blocking bridge call, so v2.x parallel lanes ran sequentially with all caps inert and blew the app's 60s provider kill -> 0 rows on device. v3.0.0 bounds the provider by fetch count instead: WINGS one server at a time (cdn/m4uhd/lamovie, meta+seed cached) -> vidlove moviebox2 -> native shegu chain only when it can work (cjRelay relay on device, direct binary in node tests). Render addon lane removed (cold wake blocks the bridge 30-60s). Native 4K on Mobile: set the 'Cinejoy relay base URL' setting to your asian-catalog worker (bundle v5.7.0+ carries /cjg + /cjs). Chain re-verified live 2026-09-14.
